subject: how to analyse the interaction between two binary exogenous variables?

messages.author: c72a7040a2ed8cad
messages.subject: how to analyse the interaction between two binary exogenous variables?
parts:
Hi all,

I know when the exogenous variable (A) is binary, it will be treated as a dummy variable.
I am wondering how about in the situation that two exogenous variables (A, B) are both binary, and their interaction also strongly influence the endogenous variable?
Simply add a AxB term like:

A   B  -->  A   B   AxB
0   0         0    0     0
0   1         0    1     0
1   0         1    0     0
1   1         1    1     1  

Thanks!
